suffix: Brand palette: deep navy and near-black background, saturated system blue (#2f7bff) and pale sky-blue highlights, glassy translucent materials, subtle blueprint grid. Landscape editorial feature image, 16:9 composition, photorealistic. Absolutely no text, words, letters, numbers, captions, watermarks, interface labels, or logos.

guides.app-store-connect-release-checklist: Overhead flat-lay on a dark navy blueprint cutting mat. On the left, a glossy translucent blue glass toy rocket lies on its side. To its right, a tidy two-column grid of eight small frosted-glass square tiles, like a pre-flight panel; six tiles glow with a soft blue light from within, two are still dark. Soft top light with crisp shadows, shallow depth of field at the edges, calm empty space along the top third.
guides.ios-app-launch-checklist: Low-angle cinematic view of a miniature launch pad made of frosted glass and brushed aluminium on a dark reflective tabletop at night. A small glossy blue glass rocket has just lifted off, a soft cone of pale blue exhaust light spreading across the pad. A thin gantry tower stands to the left. The right half of the frame is open deep-navy sky with a faint grid of light, giving breathing room.
guides.ios-app-release-management: Isometric miniature scene on a dark surface: four frosted-glass platforms in a gentle diagonal line from lower left to upper right, joined by a thin glowing blue rail. Each platform holds a small rocket at a later stage of assembly: loose parts, a bare frame, a finished body, then a polished glass rocket with a soft glow. Studio lighting, tilt-shift depth of field, generous negative space top left.
guides.app-store-review-management: Close-up of dozens of small frosted-glass speech bubbles and tiny glass star tokens drifting above a dark desk surface. A soft vertical beam of blue light sorts them into three neat stacks in the middle of the frame; a few bubbles at the edge glow warm amber. Rounded, tactile shapes, gentle bokeh in the background, empty dark space on the right side.
guides.ai-release-notes-for-ios-apps: A softly glowing blue glass orb hovers above a dark wooden desk. Below it, a messy scatter of blank index cards and torn sticky notes on the left is drawn upward in a thin stream of light and settles on the right as one clean, blank translucent card resting on a small glass stand. Warm-cool contrast, low key lighting, shallow depth of field.
guides.launchbuddy-mcp-server: Two smooth glass blocks sit on a dark desk a short distance apart: a larger frosted block on the left with a faint inner glow, and a smaller faceted crystal on the right. A short, thick cable of blue light connects them, passing through a small glass gate in the middle that is half open. The scene feels private and local, lit by a single overhead lamp, with deep shadows and empty space above.
guides.testflight-release-management: Inside a dark miniature wind tunnel lined with a faint blueprint grid, a loose formation of small frosted-glass paper airplanes glides from left to right. The lead plane is lit with a crisp blue rim light while the others trail behind in softer focus. Thin streams of pale blue light show the airflow. Cinematic side view, plenty of dark space in the upper right.
guides.indie-app-portfolio-management: A long dark display shelf seen at eye level holds five blank rounded-square glass tiles standing upright, each the shape of an app icon with nothing on it. One tile in the centre is under a bright blue spotlight and glows; two are softly lit; the two at the ends sit in shadow. Museum-like lighting, polished reflections on the shelf, calm empty wall above.
guides.ios-app-idea-backlog: A shallow dark ceramic tray on a blueprint-grid desk mat holds many tiny glowing orbs of light, like seeds, in different shades of blue. One orb has been moved out of the tray onto the grid on the right, where a delicate glass seedling with two leaves is sprouting from it. Soft macro photography, gentle side light, shallow depth of field, open space in the top half.
